title: Final Velocity Calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the impact velocity V_0 using the equation V_0 = sqrt(2gh).

title: Time Calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must accurately determine the time of descent t using the formula t = V_0/g.

title: Equation of Motion Setup
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly set up the equation of motion for the diver under water, including the balance of forces.

title: Velocity Function Derivation
description: Important Criteria: The student must derive the velocity function V as a function of depth x and apply the boundary condition V = V_0 at x = 0.

title: Depth Calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must find the depth x where V = V_0/10 using the derived equations.

title: Depth as Function of Time
description: Important Criteria: The student should derive the expression for depth x(t) in terms of time under water.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common sign mistakes in the equations of motion or when integrating.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must ensure that units are consistent throughout the calculations.
